violated_contract: An OAuth callback page that renders the error/error_description query parameters must HTML-escape them before interpolation: the values traverse the provider redirect but ultimately originate from the crafted request, so a raw interpolation is a reflected-XSS vector on an unauthenticated route. The error branches of omi-dropbox-app, omi-ms365-app, and omi-notion-app interpolated them raw (class sibling of the uid reflections fixed in #14350 and PR #13658).
canonical_prevention: Escape every reflected error field with html.escape(..., quote=True) at the interpolation site, and pin the three callback handlers with a manifest-registered hermetic suite that drives them through a hostile error value asserting the escaped form and no raw script tag.
